content.title: Akebia Therapeutics (AKBA) Is Down 29.9% After Ending VALOR Trial for Non-Dialysis CKD Patients
content.summary: On October 28, 2025, Akebia Therapeutics announced it will not proceed with the VALOR clinical trial for vadadustat in non-dialysis chronic kidney disease patients following an unsuccessful alignment with the FDA on trial design requirements. This development means Akebia will not pursue a broader U.S. label for Vafseo in this population, shifting its focus to dialysis patients and possible smaller subgroups, which could alter its growth prospects in the CKD market.
